title: UAG-MF: Uncertainty-aware generative multimodal fusion for continuous pain estimation in non-verbal patients under clinical occlusions
description: Official code repository for UAG-MF. Contains training scripts, model implementations, LOSO cross-validation, ablation studies, federated learning simulation, and figure generation code. All results reported in the manuscript are fully reproducible.
